column1: # Who fills the flight model's performance tables, and which class uses them.
# Cycle 1377 found the tables: a ten-entry speed breakpoint table at
# [model+1076..1112] and ten sixteen-byte records at [model+608 + i*16], read by
# sub_82283480 to produce the three rate limits at [+1248/1252/1256].
# BOUNDING THE POPULATION FIRST, because the naive searches are useless here:
#   stores into [+608..+767] or [+1076..+1112]   -> 58 functions
#   `addi rX,rY,608` or `,1076`                  -> 104 sites, nearly all frames
# 608 is a common stack-frame size AND a common field offset. Filtering to
# methods of THIS class family (the 36 slots of 0x82008B10 / 0x8200F270 /
# 0x8200F310) leaves exactly ONE.
# A REFUTATION THAT THE FILTER PRODUCED. sub_8225CB20 stores to +1076, +1080,
# +1088, +1092, +1096 and +1104 -- a perfect match for the breakpoint table, and
# it is NOT in this family and is not called by it. It is a different class's
# field at the same displacement. Without the filter it would have been the
# answer, and it would have been wrong. Fifteenth displacement collision this
# campaign.
# slot

column1: # THE ASYMMETRY, and it is the finding. Slot 29 is where the speed-interpolated
# lookup is driven from. 0x8200F270 -- the class that owns the position
# integrator 0x82303110 and the control surfaces 0x82302DB0 -- leaves slot 29 as
# the EMPTY virtual. Only the sibling 0x8200F310, whose own slot 31 is 505
# instructions of vector aerodynamics, resamples the table.
# So the two flight models in one entity differ in kind, not only in code: one
# takes its rate limits from whatever slot 9 established and keeps them; the
# other re-derives them from a performance curve every time slot 29 runs.
# NOT ESTABLISHED. A capsule on 0x82282408 seeded with a flat per-offset pattern
# faults after 79 of 311 steps, having written 53 words in seven runs (+16..+35,
# NONE of them in the record table. It needs a richer environment than a flat
# pattern -- it reads pointers -- and where its data comes from is open.
# Its only direct caller is 0x82303D18; the lookup's are 0x82303A20, 0x82306A38
